summary: The PR removes null checking for `user.address` in `getUserCity`, introducing a regression where passing a user object without an address property causes a `TypeError` instead of safely returning `null` or `undefined`.

findings.title: Unsafe property access throws TypeError when user address is missing
findings.description: Removing the `if (!user.address)` check causes `getUserCity` to attempt direct property access `user.address.city`. When `user.address` is undefined or null, this throws an unhandled `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'city')`.
findings.verificationHypothesis: Calling `getUserCity({})` or `getUserCity({ address: null })` throws a `TypeError` instead of returning `null` or `undefined`.

suggestedReproduction.preconditions: User object has no `address` property defined.
suggestedReproduction.expectedBehavior: Should return `null` or `undefined` without throwing an error.
suggestedReproduction.suspiciousBehavior: Throws `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'city')`.
